entry.title: Variety is the Spice of Life! #shorts #lowvision #assistivetechnology #blind

media:group.media:title: Variety is the Spice of Life! #shorts #lowvision #assistivetechnology #blind
media:group.media:description:
There is no one-size-fits-all solution when it comes to assistive technology for the blind. Just like blindness is a spectrum, so are the needs of the blind community. I often get comments on videos about assistive tech devices along the lines of "my phone can already do all of that". And that's often true, but not everyone can or wants to use a smartphone for a variety of reasons. It's important to think outside the box and consider that others may not have the same needs, wants, and skills that you do.

entry.title: Can AI Find Treatment Options for Vision Loss? Meet Nome

media:group.media:title: Can AI Find Treatment Options for Vision Loss? Meet Nome
media:group.media:description:
Finding reliable treatment information after a vision impairment diagnosis can feel overwhelming. Nome uses AI and a patient’s clinical diagnosis to identify potential treatments, medications, and other options that patients can discuss with their doctors.
In this interview, Nome CEO Stevie Ringle shares how his own vision journey inspired the organization, explains how the service works, and reveals the interesting story behind its name.
